register.labelZh: SCRUB 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: scrub something off 表示用力擦洗,把泥濘、油漬、油漆或其他痕跡從物件表面清除。；你可以 scrub dirt off a wall,表示清潔牆壁表面;也可以 scrub out a pan、bath、sink 或 bin,表示徹底清潔內部。；scrub up 和 scrub in 常用於談論醫生、護士和手術前的準備工作。；SCRUB 片語動詞表示用力而仔細地擦洗,而不只是輕輕抹一下。
register.summaryEn: Scrub something off shows that mud, grease, paint or another mark is removed from a surface by hard rubbing. You can scrub dirt off a wall, but you scrub out a pan, bath, sink or bin. Scrub up and scrub in are commonly connected with doctors, nurses and operations. SCRUB expressions show that someone cleans something firmly and carefully rather than simply wiping it.
